_comment: Pinned third-party Rust crates for the Tier A coverage study (#493).
Hermeticity here means SOURCE hermeticity — the harness only parses,
encodes and re-encodes these files with `syn`, it never builds them — so
the bar is: pure Rust, no proc-macro crates, no build.rs code generation,
no FFI/`extern` bindings to a C library, permissively licensed, and small
enough to shallow-clone. Each `ref` is a commit SHA resolved from the
repo's default branch on 2026-09-03 via the GitHub API, so a Tier A number
is reproducible; bump it deliberately, never to chase a number. `lib` is
the subtree that is actually studied. An unreachable pin is reported
separately and is NOT scored as a failure.
